== Summary ==

Crop rectangle <code>(261, 1127, 2324, 4012)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a9c7f7d0325eba4c1a992baa2b97b119cff445b8da7530f9e1cabbf950a5f077</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
